notes.title: Some small features implemented
notes.content:
Feature list:

 Level Progress Saving: Your progress is now saved — you no longer have to restart levels when revisiting.
 Resizable Sub-windows: Adjust the size of each section (Code, Output, Goal, Input) to your preference.
 Clearer Code Block Separators: Improved visibility of code block dividers and clearer movement restrictions.
 Reset Progress Option: Start fresh anytime by deleting all your progress.
